context: A uni student helps a teen friend plan a spring outing
purpose: Teach: スゴイ/おやじ/黄色い/ちっとも/敢えて/まもなく/咲く/辿り

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: ねえ先輩、もうまもなく春休みじゃん？どっか連れてってよ！
lines.en: Hey senpai, spring break is almost here, right? Take me somewhere!
lines.style: Teen girl, bouncy and pleading, casual sentence-final particles.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 急だな。まあ、桜が咲くころに花見でも行くか。
lines.en: That's sudden. Well, we could go flower-viewing when the cherry blossoms bloom.
lines.style: Uni student, calm and slightly teasing, relaxed plain form.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 花見いいね！うちのおやじが、造幣局の通り抜けがスゴイって毎年言ってるんだよね。
lines.en: Flower-viewing sounds great! My dad says the Mint's walkway is amazing every year.
lines.style: Teen girl, enthusiastic, name-dropping family with warm familiarity.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: ああ、梅田から歩いて行けるとこな。八重桜だから、黄色いのとかピンクのとか種類が多いんだよ。
lines.en: Ah, the place you can walk to from Umeda. They're double cherries, so there are many kinds, yellow ones, pink ones.
lines.style: Uni student, explanatory and knowledgeable, gentle senior tone.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 黄色い桜とか想像つかない！正直、種類とかちっとも知らないし。
lines.en: I can't even picture yellow cherry blossoms! Honestly, I don't know anything about the varieties.
lines.style: Teen girl, wide-eyed surprise mixed with self-deprecating laughter.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: じゃあ敢えてマニアックな順路で行こうぜ。地図を辿りながら、桜にまつわる話もしてやるよ。
lines.en: Then let's dare to take a nerdy route. While we trace the map, I'll even tell you stories about cherry blossoms.
lines.style: Uni student, playful challenge, slightly showing off knowledge.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: うわ、ガイド付き！じゃあ私はおやじに弁当頼んどく。期待しててね、先輩！
lines.en: Whoa, with a guide! Then I'll ask my dad to make bentos. Look forward to it, senpai!
lines.style: Teen girl, excited high energy, planning out loud.
